来源：SEC EDGAR 公司披露数据，点击日期可查看申报原文。* 表示由累计披: Source: SEC EDGAR company facts, as filed. Tap a date for the filing. * is derived by subtracting cumulative figures. TTM adds the latest four contiguous quarters and is omitted when they don't connect; TTM EPS needs a reported fourth quarter, so it usually stays empty. EPS is as filed and not adjusted for later stock splits, so jumps across a split are not real changes. ROE uses period-end equity. Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital expenditure. History length depends on each company's XBRL filings (generally from 2009) and restatements use the latest filed value.
